name: Alora Asami
source:
She was a prodigy from a young age, inventing medication to 'fix' people. She's very keen on the ideas of efficiency, perfection, and purity. She's very blunt in general and will avoid conversations whenever possible. From an outside eye it appears that Alora doesn't display nor feel a single emotion and holds no particular person above another.

In class trials she will most likely easily be able to work out how a murder was committed but will have difficulty working out the culprit as she often can't figure out motives.

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CYR-cIltVhB/]official description[/url]]
